entities.name: Query MurE ligase
observations: 513 aa protein with Pfam Mur_ligase, Mur_ligase_M, and Mur_ligase_C domains spanning the catalytic architecture.
Closest reviewed homologs are MurE ligases with 41.3–44.6% identity and 96.1–96.7% query coverage.
Predicted cytosolic enzyme; likely ATP- and Mg2+-dependent.

entities.name: MurE ligase reaction
observations: Reaction is assigned EC 6.3.2.13 and Rhea RHEA:23676 in close reviewed homologs.
The reaction incorporates meso-diaminopimelate into the peptidoglycan nucleotide precursor.

entities.name: MurE Mg2+ dependence
observations: Close reviewed homologs annotate Mg2+ as a cofactor and ATP binding as a molecular function.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE ligase catalysis occurs in bacterial cell-wall peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
